source: Consumes honua-io/honua-server capability-keys.v1.json (KEY_LIST_URL override; config/capability-keys.fixture.json pinned fallback). See scripts/lib/capability-key-list.mjs and honua-io/honua-server#2893.
vocabulary: samples/catalog.v2.json entry `capabilities` slugs (SDK-feature vocabulary, distinct from the canonical capabilityKeys vocabulary)

analysis.reason: Generic use-case label describing a workbench that composes several analysis operations; the specific canonical capabilities it exercises (e.g. aggregation) already carry their own crosswalk entries.

analytics.reason: kepler.gl client-side visualization/replay integration; no server-side platform capability is exercised.

app-bootstrap.reason: Legacy @honua/app-platform compatibility bootstrap shim; SDK-internal, no platform capability.

arcgis.reason: Marks a sample as an ArcGIS JS API source fixture for the migration harness; not itself a platform capability.

bounded-local.reason: Describes an execution-boundary/performance property (bounded local compute), not a platform capability.

camera.reason: Client-side map camera/viewport state; rendering-pipeline concern, not a platform capability.

cancellation.reason: Client-side fetch/query cancellation mechanics; no corresponding platform capability key.

catalog.reason: Generic 'browses a service catalog' label spanning many protocols; the specific protocol being browsed carries its own crosswalk entry.

codemod.reason: ArcGIS JS API static-analysis/rewrite tooling; dev-time only, not a platform capability.

columnar.reason: Describes GeoParquet's columnar storage format; GeoParquet has no canonical capability key.

compatibility.reason: Generic ArcGIS-compatibility audit label; the specific compatible capabilities are proven by their own tags elsewhere.

controls.reason: Client-side UI control widgets; not a platform capability.

custom-elements.reason: Web Components custom-element framework binding; not a platform capability.

direct-connect.reason: SDK's zero-Honua-server-round-trip connect() architecture; SDK-internal, not itself a platform capability.

explain-plan.reason: SDK query-planner transparency feature (explains a query plan before running it); SDK-internal, not a platform capability.

fidelity.reason: Compares the SDK's own MapLibre/Cesium rendering fidelity; client rendering-pipeline concern, not a platform capability.

filtering.reason: Generic cross-view filter synchronization; client-side UI plumbing, not a platform capability (temporal filtering specifically is covered by the temporal tag).

geoparquet.reason: Client-only cloud-native columnar format profiling; GeoParquet has no canonical capability key in the published vocabulary.

idempotency.reason: Client-side idempotent edit-retry mechanics; an implementation quality of editing, not a distinct platform capability.

interaction-state.reason: SDK's automatic MapLibre source-strategy interaction/refresh/disposal lifecycle; SDK-internal, not a platform capability.

large-data.reason: Describes a performance property (large dataset handling), not a platform capability.

linked-filters.reason: Client-side cross-widget filter linking (kepler.gl); UI plumbing, not a platform capability.

linked-views.reason: Client-side cross-view linking (map/table/chart); UI plumbing, not a platform capability.

map.reason: Generic base-map rendering; too broad to correspond to one platform capability (specific protocols/serving capabilities carry their own tags).

migration.reason: ArcGIS-to-Honua migration codemod and scan tooling; dev-time only, not a platform capability.

node.reason: Marks a sample as running in Node rather than a browser; a runtime-environment property, not a platform capability.

offline.reason: Describes serverless/static (no-Honua-server) operation in this sample; distinct from fieldops.offline-sync's field-data synchronization meaning, which the SDK does not exercise via this tag.

optimistic-concurrency.reason: Client-side optimistic-concurrency/ETag handling; an editing implementation detail, not a distinct platform capability.

optimistic-updates.reason: Client-side optimistic UI update mechanics; an editing implementation detail, not a distinct platform capability.

planning.reason: Generic use-case/domain label ("planning and permitting"), not a technical platform capability.

progressive-rendering.reason: Client-side progressive/streamed rendering of query results; SDK-internal rendering concern, not a platform capability.

protocols.reason: Generic "demonstrates multiple protocols" label; the specific protocols carry their own crosswalk entries elsewhere.

provenance.reason: SDK-side data-provenance annotation/UI concept; not itself a platform capability.

query.reason: Generic protocol-neutral query label spanning every backend; the specific protocol being queried carries its own crosswalk entry.

range-reads.reason: Client-side HTTP range-read query mechanics for GeoParquet; GeoParquet has no canonical capability key.

react.reason: React framework binding; not a platform capability.

reconciliation.reason: Client-side realtime state-reconciliation loop; an implementation detail of realtime sync, not a distinct platform capability.

renderer-adapters.reason: SDK's pluggable MapLibre/Cesium renderer-adapter architecture; SDK-internal, not a platform capability.

replay.reason: Client-side operation replay for kepler.gl visualization; UI feature, not a platform capability.

runtime.reason: SDK's MapLibre-first runtime layer generally; too broad to correspond to one platform capability.

selection.reason: Client-side feature-selection state; UI plumbing, not a platform capability.

server.reason: Marks a sample as a backend/server-side usage context; a runtime-environment property, not a platform capability.

snapping.reason: Client-side geometry snapping during sketch/edit interactions; a UI editing aid, not a distinct platform capability.

storytelling.reason: Client-side narrative/camera-flythrough composition; not a platform capability.

strategy-selection.reason: SDK's automatic MapLibre rendering-strategy selection; SDK-internal, not itself a platform capability.

suggest.reason: Geocoding autosuggest UX; the published vocabulary only distinguishes forward/reverse/batch/failover geocoding, none of which name autosuggest specifically.

workspace.reason: Generic composed-workspace UI shell; not a platform capability.
